loc.frostmere_gate.name: Frostmere Gate
loc.frostmere_gate.description: A weathered stone arch marks the entrance to the settlement. Snow drifts against the pillars.

loc.mead_hall.name: The Mead Hall
loc.mead_hall.description: Long benches line a smoky room. A fire pit crackles at the centre.

loc.old_shrine.name: Old Shrine
loc.old_shrine.description: A moss-covered altar stands in a hollow. The air is unnaturally still.

loc.frozen_well.name: Frozen Well
loc.frozen_well.description: A stone well, its rope stiff with ice.

loc.trading_post.name: Trading Post
loc.trading_post.description: Crates and furs are stacked under a sagging awning.

loc.icy_creek.name: Icy Creek
loc.icy_creek.description: Meltwater runs fast over black stones. Something green grows at the edge.

loc.forge.name: The Forge
loc.forge.description: Heat pours from the coals. Tools hang in neat rows.

loc.pinewood.name: Pinewood
loc.pinewood.description: Dense pines close overhead. Tracks cross the snow.

item.frost_herbs.name: Frost Herbs
item.frost_herbs.description: Pale leaves that keep their colour in the cold.

item.ember_shard.name: Ember Shard
item.ember_shard.description: A fragment of slag that never cools.

npc.innkeeper.name: Innkeeper
npc.innkeeper.description: A broad woman polishing a horn cup.
dialogue: Sit by the fire if you like.

npc.trader.name: Fur Trader
npc.trader.description: A wiry man counting pelts under his breath.
dialogue: Good pelts fetch a good price.
The wolf out east has ruined my stock.

npc.shrine_keeper.name: Shrine Keeper
npc.shrine_keeper.description: An old man in frost-stiffened robes.
dialogue: Have you been to the creek?

npc.snow_wolf.name: Snow Wolf
npc.snow_wolf.description: Lean and grey, watching from the treeline.

npc.forge_wraith.name: Forge Wraith
npc.forge_wraith.description: A shape of heat-haze and ash that will not leave the coals.

quest.herbs.name: Herbs for the Shrine
quest.herbs.description: Bring Frost Herbs to the Shrine Keeper.

quest.wolf.name: The Snow Wolf
quest.wolf.description: Kill the snow wolf in Pinewood and return with its pelt.
